F012.title: Repository pattern for projects
F012.notes: Drizzle repository pattern with typed CRUD, transaction support, undefined narrowing for .returning()

F013.title: Repository pattern for features
F013.notes: Feature repository following F012 project.ts template exactly. Added findByProject, findByStatus, bulkUpdateStatus (inArray), and findDependencies (JSON column resolution). Zero retries, clean first pass.

F014.title: Repository pattern for sessions
F014.notes: Session repository with CRUD, findActive (inArray), appendOutput (SQL CASE WHEN), calculateDuration helper, and withTransaction support. 31 comprehensive tests. Clean execution following F012/F013 pattern template.

F015.title: Hono server setup with oRPC
F015.notes: Extended Hono server from F001 scaffold with oRPC routing, error handlers (app.onError, app.notFound), PORT binding via export default, and comprehensive unit tests. 4 acceptance criteria verified at runtime.

F016.title: Health check endpoint
F016.notes: XS-sized health endpoint with actual database connectivity check (sql`SELECT 1`), HTTP 503 on failure, and comprehensive test coverage. Pattern reuse from F015 error handling. Added sql re-export to @nomos-ai/db package.

F017.title: Projects oRPC router
F017.notes: M-sized oRPC CRUD router with Zod validation, repository integration, and error handling. 36 comprehensive tests (all passed first try). Pattern reuse from F015 procedure foundation. All 4 acceptance criteria verified. Type cast needed for Zod object -> Drizzle Record in settings field.

F018.title: Features oRPC router
F018.notes: M-sized oRPC CRUD router with 7 procedures (list, get, create, update, delete, updateStatus, bulkUpdateStatus). Transition validation pattern for state machine enforcement. Copied project.ts template with minimal customization. Feature repository integration with status filtering and bulk operations. 442 tests in test suite. All acceptance criteria verified on first try. Demonstrates extreme pattern reuse efficiency (5 min).

F019.title: Sessions oRPC router
F019.notes: L-sized oRPC CRUD router with 9 procedures (list, get, create, update, delete, listActive, updateStatus, appendOutput, getDuration). Reused feature.ts template with session-specific status transitions (pending→running→completed|failed). 429 tests in test suite. All tests passed on first run. Demonstrates template reuse efficiency with state machine enforcement (updateStatus + getDuration for duration tracking).

F020.title: React app with TanStack Router
F020.notes: M-sized React web app with 3 TanStack Router routes (/projects/, /projects/$projectId, /features/$featureId). File-based routing with beforeLoad auth guards, type-safe route params, oRPC queryOptions for type-safe data fetching. Pattern reuse from F001 scaffold (auth, components, routing structure). Zero retries despite first frontend feature. All 4 acceptance criteria verified.

F022.title: Zustand store for global state
F022.notes: Zustand store with 4 typed slices (projects, features, sessions, UI), StateCreator generics pattern, devtools integration with named actions, optimized curried selectors, and comprehensive test suite (22 tests). Store creation pattern for combining slices. All 4 acceptance criteria verified on first try.
